action.command: cd /workspace && ls public/assets/*.js public/assets/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -8; ls public/assets | grep -cE "\.(js|css)$"; ls -la public/assets/.sprockets-manifest* 2>/dev/null; echo "=== memcached ==="; (echo -e "version\r"; sleep 0.3) | timeout 3 bash -c 'cat > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/11211' 2>/dev/null; printf 'version\r\nquit\r\n' | timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/11211; cat >&3; cat <&3' 2>/dev/null | head -2

tool_call.name: terminal
